nonBlockingIssues.description: Inconsistent NONE guard pattern: destroy_texture has explicit is_none() check, destroy_mesh/destroy_material/destroy_skeleton do not. All are safe via ResourceStorage::remove returning None.
destroy_material does not free material_descriptor_set (currently always None). Will leak if descriptor sets are later populated.
test_default_textures_preserved provides minimal coverage (tests handle indices 0-4 are not u32::MAX, not actual default texture protection).
test_destroy_texture only tests NONE handle detection, not actual texture destruction logic.
NewScene editor action still has stale warn! about GPU leak and doesn't use gpu_resource_tracker.release_all(). Relies on per-entity ECS event cleanup instead.
ComponentEvent::Removed not integrated for standalone DrawableComponent removal. Only entity destruction triggers GPU cleanup via EntityEvent::Destroyed.
GLTF textures uploaded in spawn_gltf_model are never tracked in GpuResourceTracker. track_texture() API exists but is unused. Textures leak on scene load.

appliedUpdates.description: Added GPU Resource Cleanup section to architecture.md documenting GpuResourceTracker initialization, cleanup patterns, shared resource handling, and known gaps (GLTF textures not tracked, ComponentEvent::Removed not integrated)
Added material_descriptor_set always-None caveat and inconsistent NONE guard pattern note to GPU Resource Destroy APIs section in architecture.md

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When implementing GPU cleanup features, workers should search for all warn! messages about GPU leaks (not just the one mentioned in the feature description) and remove/update them all. The NewScene action in editor/mod.rs had the same warn! as scene/mod.rs but was missed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: scene-load-gpu-cleanup worker removed warn! from scene/mod.rs load_scene but missed identical message in editor/mod.rs NewScene action (line 205)
